---
name: Research team onboarding
about: Checklist for a new member of the research team
title: "On-boarding <your_name>"
---

Check off each item as you complete it. Ask questions in the comments.

## Setup

- [ ] Join the Research team Slack channel (see
      [how to join](https://github.com/gpsaggese/gpsaggese.github.io/blob/master/policies/how_to_join_the_research_team.md))
- [ ] Fork the repo, if you are not a collaborator (see
      [how to contribute](https://github.com/gpsaggese/gpsaggese.github.io/blob/master/class_project/how_to_contribute.md))
- [ ] Install Docker and run a project container (see
      [Docker scripts](https://github.com/gpsaggese/gpsaggese.github.io/blob/master/class_project/project_template/docker_scripts.README.md))

## Read

- [ ] [FAQ](https://github.com/gpsaggese/gpsaggese.github.io/blob/master/policies/FAQ.md)
- [ ] [My AI Policy](https://github.com/gpsaggese/gpsaggese.github.io/blob/master/website/docs/blog/posts/My_AI_Policy.md)
- [ ] [How to create a PR with Claude Code](https://github.com/gpsaggese/gpsaggese.github.io/blob/master/policies/pr_process.how_to_guide.md)
- [ ] [How to contribute](https://github.com/gpsaggese/gpsaggese.github.io/blob/master/class_project/how_to_contribute.md)
- [ ] [Tutorial checklist](https://github.com/gpsaggese/gpsaggese.github.io/blob/master/tutorials/tutorials_checklist.md)
- [ ] [Must-read checklist](https://github.com/gpsaggese/helpers/blob/master/docs/onboarding/all.dev_must_read_checklist.reference.md)

## Start

- [ ] Pick a project from
      [the project list](https://github.com/gpsaggese/gpsaggese.github.io/blob/master/research/contributors.md)
      and write its name here:
- [ ] Create an issue for your first task
- [ ] Open a small first PR (e.g., a doc fix)

## For GP

- [ ] Give repo access
- [ ] Add the member to
      [`research/contributors.md`](https://github.com/gpsaggese/gpsaggese.github.io/blob/master/research/contributors.md)
